game.title: Saints Row: Gat Out of Hell
game.blurb: Open-world action game set in the city of New Hades, a standalone expansion to Saints Row IV, from Volition and High Voltage Software, released 2015-01-20. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story, Co-op and Play Time
chapters.summary: Beating the game, playing as both Gat and Kinzie, co-op and long stays in Hell.

chapters.title: Supernatural Powers
chapters.summary: Stone Blast, Stomp, Summon and Coldfire Aura, new elements, upgrades and your own Imps.

chapters.title: Flight
chapters.summary: Flying, gliding and staying airborne across New Hades.

chapters.title: The Seven Deadly Weapons
chapters.summary: The Seven Deadly Weapons, the Essences, the God's Hammer and weapon upgrades.

chapters.title: City Takeover and Challenges
chapters.summary: Open-world activities in each district, City Take Over, Arch Dukes, diversions and the Challenges.

chapters.title: Tomes and Soul Clusters
chapters.summary: Finding the Tomes and Soul Clusters scattered around the city.

chapters.title: Stunts and Mayhem
chapters.summary: Lava, comets, wall running, Imps and other silly feats.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Saints Row: Gat Out of Hell" or "Saints Row: Gat out of Hell". saintsrow.fandom.com answers the API under "Saints Row: Gat out of Hell", with about 100 linked articles, including "Activities and Diversions in Saints Row: Gat out of Hell", "Challenges in Saints Row: Gat out of Hell" and "New Hades"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Its summary calls the game a standalone expansion to Saints Row IV. The Steam schema calls the app "Project Gat" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 301910 as "Saints Row: Gat out of Hell". None of the 45 Steam achievements is hidden. Only one achievement ("Satan Punchers", beat the game) marks story progress, so the story chapter also holds the co-op and play-time goals. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours.
